summary:
LETS GOOOOO WEEK 3 IN THE BOOKS AND WE GOT SOME ABSOLUTE BANGERS AND SOME BRUTAL BEATDOWNS! BOOM!

First off, we gotta talk about "The Annihilator" Langland putting up a TWELVE POINT FOURTEEN! Are you KIDDING me right now?! Joe Milton went full NEGATIVE TERRITORY with -0.4 points, Ben Sinnott gave us a BAGEL, and the best player on this roster was Malik Washington with 4.7 points! This is like watching the 2008 Detroit Lions try to play basketball - it's not even the right sport anymore! Meanwhile powerperson absolutely STEAMROLLED them by 93.42 points with Cam Skattebo dropping 21.1 and Michael Pittman adding 16.3. This wasn't a football game, this was a CRIME SCENE! FOR THE BRAND, somebody check on Langland because that's the kind of performance that makes you question your entire lineup strategy!

Your HERO OF THE WEEK is "The Upset Artist" drobs, who came in ranked #6 in the power rankings and ABSOLUTELY DEMOLISHED the #1 ranked cosmohouck by nearly 30 points! David Montgomery went NUCLEAR with 28.9 points, and Mark Andrews was an absolute WEAPON with 24.1! That's 53 points from TWO GUYS! Meanwhile cosmohouck - who we're calling "The Fallen King" this week - got a nice 31.3 from Jonathan Taylor but watched Malik Nabers put up a PATHETIC 2.3 and Tetairoa McMillan give us 6.3. This is like when Buster Douglas knocked out Mike Tyson in Tokyo - NOBODY saw it coming, but when the smoke cleared, the underdog was standing tall! BANGER of a performance from drobs!

"The Cardiac Kid" TophTT came through with another ELECTRIC showing, dropping 119.34 on PrinceofPizza! Lamar Jackson put on a CLINIC with 27.0 points and Omarion Hampton was EATING with 21.9! Meanwhile PrinceofPizza is over here starting BOTH Daniel Jones AND Kyler Murray at quarterback and watching CeeDee Lamb put up a ZERO BURGER! Brother, when your best players are your two mediocre QBs combining for under 30 points, you're in TROUBLE! This man left points ALL OVER his bench and got absolutely worked! 

The VILLAIN OF THE WEEK has gotta be "Benchwarmer General" mastab24, who won his matchup 125.82 to 69.36 but STILL managed to leave 25 points on the bench with terrible lineup decisions! You put up 125 and STILL could've had 150?! That's like winning the lottery and then finding another winning ticket in your other pocket! Jalen Hurts saved your bacon with 29.0 points and Courtland Sutton added 20.8, but Cade Otton gave you a GOOSE EGG! Meanwhile tr4sh had Jayden Daniels ghost him with 0.0 points - when your starting QB doesn't show up, you're COOKED! LETS GOOOOO, what a week of absolute CHAOS! FOR THE BRAND!
